alerts.headline: Special Marine Warning issued November 20 at 1:34PM EST until November 20 at 2:30PM EST by NWS Jacksonville FL
alerts.description:
SMWJAX

The National Weather Service in Jacksonville has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Waters from Fernandina Beach to St. Augustine FL from 20 to 60
NM...
Waters from St. Augustine to Flagler Beach FL from 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 230 PM EST.

* At 134 PM EST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing
waterspouts was located 38 nm east of Daytona Beach Shores, or 39
nm east of South D
alerts.areaDesc: Waters from Fernandina Beach to St. Augustine FL from 20 to 60 NM; Waters from St. Augustine to Flagler Beach FL from 20 to 60 NM

alerts.headline: wind warning — Paulatuk
alerts.description:
Damaging winds are expected.

Winds from the south will strengthen today and tonight. The strongest winds are expected near midnight with gusts of 90 km/h. Winds will diminish on Saturday.
The strong winds will likely cause poor visibility in blowing snow at times.

Secure loose objects. Prepare for possible disruptions to transportation, services, and utilities.

Please continue to monitor alerts
